raw_context: "lakas ng amats ko, sobrang natural, walang halong kemikal" — Shanti Dope, Amatz (2019); referenced in DRUGS EP (2024) Facebook post: "yung gusto ko ikwento yung amat sa'kin ng musika"
"Lutang" — Shanti Dope feat. Bry Mnzno, Buddahbeads, Ejac (2020); used to mean spaced out / blissfully disconnected; thematically central to DRUGS EP (2024) portrayal of being mentally adrift
"deds" appears in Bad Type lyric extraction — Guns and Roses (2023); meaning: dead / hopeless / it's over / a lost cause
"Yung sabi ko sa tropa, mag-ingat ka palagi" — Bad Type, Guns and Roses (2023); also: "Minsan kung may tropa ang hirap iwasan uminom" — Shanti Dope interview on Rehab (2025)
"Tulak sa'min si 2Pac tingin sakin" — Bad Type, Guns and Roses (2023); Last.fm lyric snippet confirms street dealer usage in narrative
"Laylow sh gulat ka noh" — Shanti Dope feat. Skinny G of Acdmnd$, Peekaboo! (2021, active in 2023-2025 PH rap lexicon); meaning: stay low / keep a low profile / avoid attention
"kamatayan o parak" — Shanti Dope, Amatz (2019, culturally active 2023-2025); meaning: police; street slang for law enforcement
Described in review of Shanti Dope Rehab (2025) as slang used in the song meaning lost / reckless / going astray; Bandwagon Asia and Rolling Stone PH coverage of the track
Flagged in coverage of Shanti Dope's Rehab (2025): "sabog = wasted/high" — used to describe the pre-recovery state depicted in the song's narrative

"the lyrics reflect the Filipino slang 'diskarte,' which means being resourceful and innovative" — Shanti Dope discography coverage (sonichits.com); used across his catalog as core identity term in interviews 2023-2025
"babatain" extracted from Bad Type lyrics (Guns and Roses, 2023); meaning: to disrespect / insult / drag someone publicly
"Ano kamo baguhan pero kilos beterano" — Shanti Dope feat. Skinny G of Acdmnd$, Peekaboo! (2021, active 2023-2025); adapted Filipino spelling of "veteran"; used as street credibility descriptor
"makinang na bato, mapadamuhang mabango" — Shanti Dope, Amatz (2019); street slang for crystal methamphetamine / shabu; thematic backbone of DRUGS EP (2024); "kamatayan o parak" line follows
